description: Structural editing and reference propagation (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §8): how rename / move / delete / insert change what a reference resolves to. `edit` describes the gesture (op + target, evaluated against the pre-edit workspace); `caller`/`reference` is the affected formula; `expect.outcome` is the post-edit resolution — `rebound` = resolves to a different/renamed node, `unresolved` = #REF!.

cases.name: deleting a node breaks references to it
cases.note: Income's =Sales*Margin loses its Margin binding -> Unresolved (#REF!); undo affords recovery.

cases.name: rename with propagation rewrites and rebinds references
cases.note: With propagation accepted, Income's formula text is rewritten Margin->GrossMargin and rebinds to the renamed node.

cases.name: rename without propagation leaves a dangling reference
cases.note: Declining propagation leaves =Sales*Margin pointing at a name that no longer exists -> Unresolved.

cases.name: moving a node out of scope breaks a relative reference
cases.note: After the move, Margin leaves Income's walk-up scope (now under Total) -> Unresolved. The move prompt warns about references that resolve differently.

cases.name: inserting a closer-scoped node shadows the prior resolution
cases.note: Income gains its own child Margin; walk-up is nearest-wins, so Income's =Sales*Margin now binds the new own-child, shadowing the sibling Q1.Margin.
